Herein, we have employed the gradient of the phase-field variable to define 𝛿𝑐. A factor ‘2’ is obtained in the form of 𝛿𝑐, due to the identity constraint of the Dirac-delta function. This factor leads to a change in the form of the crack opening displacement [[𝐮⋅𝒏]]. It is given as a line integral of 2𝐮⋅∇𝑑in the direction normal to the crack.
